title: How to make lemonade
text:
Lemonade is a cold drink for a hot day. It is easy to make at home.

You need: 3 lemons, 4 spoons of sugar, a jug of cold water, ice.

First, ask a grown-up to cut the lemons in half. Next, squeeze the juice into a jug. Take out any seeds.

Then add the sugar and the cold water. Stir it well until the sugar is gone. Last, add some ice and pour the lemonade into cups.

Now you can enjoy your cold, sweet drink!
